quarterly_data.signal: Company (annual report): working with the leading global memory maker that leads the drafting of industry standards and product specifications, Giantec launched VPD chips for next-generation high-performance storage devices, providing key-parameter management, device identification and system-level verification; the company says it became the first VPD chip developer to enter that maker's product design validation stage supporting its new-generation EDSFF eSSD modules and CXL memory modules, which it expects to widen the product line's market.
